name: Ishida Kanami-san no Yuuutsu
original_name: 石田佳奈美さんの憂鬱
source:
Kanako Ishida didn't go straight home and got locked up in the public lavatory by a strange man.
Restraint by the handcuff, she could not resist the violation!

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049500.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
石田佳奈美沒有直接回家，而是被一個奇怪的男人鎖在公共廁所裡。
她的雙手被手銬束縛，無法反抗這場侵犯！

[編輯自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049500.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
